'''Jerf Huxley's cantina''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that was frequented by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] including [[Jerf Huxley]] and [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Huxlings]]. Its decor was markedly different from [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and the other [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], including gaudy wall hangings, old plumbing and polished [[Droid/Legends|droid]] parts from before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The cantina had unbreakable mugs and stone-topped tables, both signs of the frequent [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fights that took place there.<ref name="Survivor's Quest" />

In [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] met with Huxley at the cantina to terminate [[Talon Karrde]]'s working relationship with the Huxlings. This prompted Huxley to confront Jade Skywalker and try extracting a severance payment from Karrde, with the aid of about twenty Huxlings, including [[Sinker (smuggler)|Sinker]].<ref name="Survivor's Quest" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jerf Huxley's cantina first appeared in the [[2004]] ''[[Star Wars]]'' novel ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'' written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Survivor's Quest" />
